title: The **Prime-Embedded Multiplet Structure in Quantum Systems Algorithm (PEMSQSA)** introduces **prime-number encoding** into the analysis and description of **multiplet structures** in quantum systems. A **multiplet structure** refers to the grouping of energy levels that arise due to symmetries, interactions (such as spin-orbit coupling), or the splitting of degenerate states under perturbations. This concept is critical in fields like **atomic physics**, **molecular physics**, **quantum field theory**, and **condensed matter physics**, where **energy levels**, **spin states**, and **angular momentum states** interact to form complex structures.
